q: Fill in the blanks: A basket of rotten oranges ____________ thrown away.
Arabian Nights ____ still wonderful to read.
The committee presented _____ recommendations to the board.
e: Committee একটি collective noun, এবং একক দল হিসেবে কাজ করলে এটিকে neuter ধরে singular pronoun দিয়ে নির্দেশ করা হয়। তাই শূন্যস্থানে its বসে। মনে রাখুন: its হলো it-এর possessive রূপ, আর it's মানে it is বা it has; দুটিকে গুলিয়ে ফেলা চলবে না। there কোনো মালিকানা বোঝায় না এবং their বহুবচনের মালিকানা বোঝায়, তাই এখানে খাপ খায় না।

q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: Neither Ali’s parents nor he was present at the ceremony.
Neither Ali’s parents nor he were present at the ceremony.
Neither Ali nor his parents was present at the ceremony.
Neither Ali nor his parents were present at the ceremony.

q: Two books in addition to a pen _______________ to each of them.
Many a student _____ to qualify the driving test on the first day.
Identify the correct sentence:
o: No one, including the experts, solves the puzzle.
No one, including the experts, could solving the puzzle.
No one, including the experts, solve the puzzle.
No one, including the experts, can solves the puzzle.

q: Choose the correct sentence:
o: Either Ratul nor his brothers is available.
Neither Ratul nor his brothers are available.
Either Ratul or his brother are available.
Neither Ratul nor his brothers is available.

q: One-third of the work ____ finished.
Choose the correct sentence-
o: Ten thousand dollar is the prize money offered in the game show.
Ten thousand dollars are the prize money offered in the game show.
Ten thousand dollars were the prize money offered in the game show.
Ten thousand dollars is the prize money offered in the game show.

q: A number of candidates _____ waiting outside the examination hall.
Many a tale____ told by the pilgrims.
The innings ______ very exciting yesterday.
e: Ethics, gallows, innings, mathematics, news, physics, politics-জাতীয় noun দেখতে plural হলেও সবসময় singular verb নেয়। তাই The innings-এর পরে singular verb বসে। Yesterday থাকায় বাক্যটি অতীত কালের, তাই is নয়, was হবে। বাক্যের অর্থ: গতকালের ইনিংসটি খুবই উত্তেজনাপূর্ণ ছিল।

q: The manager and the accountant ______ discussing the annual report.
e: দুটি একবচন noun and দিয়ে যুক্ত হলে সাধারণত বহুবচন subject গঠিত হয় এবং বহুবচন verb বসে। এখানে manager ও accountant প্রত্যেকের আগে আলাদা the আছে, অর্থাৎ দুজন পৃথক ব্যক্তি, তাই are discussing সঠিক। সঠিক বাক্য: The manager and the accountant are discussing the annual report. একজন ব্যক্তি দুই ভূমিকায় থাকলে একটি the থাকে এবং verb একবচন হয় (The manager and accountant is...)। Is ও was একবচন, has কাল ও রূপ মেলে না।

q: All of the people attending the seminar are ___________.
Neither the teacher nor the students _______ conscious of their duty.
A. One of the boys is meeting me today.
o: One of the boys are meeting me today.
One of the boy is meeting me today.
One of the boy's is meeting me today.

q: Muna as well as Runa _______ going to the party tonight.
Many a student _______ inspired by a dedicated teacher.
Which of the following is correct:
o: Bread and butter are my favourite breakfast.
Rice and curry is a popular dish.
Honesty and hard work brings success.
e: And দিয়ে দুটি subject যুক্ত হলে সাধারণত plural verb বসে, কিন্তু দুটি শব্দ মিলে একটি একক জিনিস বা ধারণা বোঝালে singular verb হয়। Rice and curry মিলে একটি খাবার বোঝায়, তাই is শুদ্ধ। একই রকম: bread and butter, fish and chips। He and I-এর সঙ্গে am চলে না, আর honesty ও hard work আলাদা দুটি গুণ বলে সেখানে plural verb দরকার।
